address: Route du Col-de-la-Faucille, lieu-dit La Mainaz, Gex, 01170, France
bio: At the Faucille Pass, between the Geneva Basin and the Haut-Jura, this regional landmark, decked out in contemporary fashion, commands a stunning view of Mont Blanc and Lake Geneva. Attractive dishes in the zeitgeist are presented in surprise menus starring premium ingredients: Arctic char, turbot, calf’s sweetbread. Its sibling, Le Panorama, is more affordable....
